name: Impact vs. Effort Matrix
deliverable: 2x2 prioritization of quick wins, major projects, and time sinks

steps.text: Draw the impact and effort axes and define both ends.
Place items against one agreed baseline, impact first.
Shift by real effort, not coding hours alone.
Push every card off the center line.
Read each quadrant and name its action.

failure: Effort optimism and pet-feature impact inflate every card until the grid crowds one corner and ranks nothing.
intervention: Ask what the item costs beyond coding hours, compare it with a known small change, and order the top three.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: Widely used in product prioritization; no single documented originator.
